_why_300k: T_eval=300k gives T0=150k > PILOT_END=125k (K0=4,w=50k,s=25k). Minimum safe budget that keeps nominal K0/w/s intact.
_why_2g: 1.5× gravity (g=-14.715) produced positive beta_TS for 11/15 drift runs — policy absorbed the perturbation. 2× (g=-19.62) doubles effective load; expected to collapse reward in ≥ 2/3 seeds.
_scale_up_criterion: If A_deg fires in ≥ 2/3 seeds: scale up to full 5-seed × 3-drift-type run. If not: try ObsNoisePerturbation with noise_std_max=0.3.
_seeds_note: One seed per condition = 3 runs. Seeds chosen for diversity: M1s0 (tau_warn=2.80e-4, high), M2s0 (tau_warn=4.26e-5, low), M3s0 (tau_warn=1.55e-4, mid).
